required.text: Godot is presentation only. Logical rules, item rolls and progression belong in the engine-free Core. Identify concrete violations with an execution path.
Persist ownership, identity, resource and random state. Corrupt or incompatible data must not silently overwrite a good save. Look for duplication, unchecked transactions and lost progression.
Commands and state must reproduce under the pinned runtime. Unbounded trigger chains, multiple death rewards, missing cleanup and iteration order dependent outcomes are bugs.

Distinguish implemented behavior from stated future work and unperformed hardware or external playtest gates. Report actionable defects in changed code; do not assume missing files or invent API behavior.
